methodology: BENCHMARKS.md §2: >=20 samples (p50/p95 nearest-rank), metric type labelled, cold/warm stated, /proc based (no /usr/bin/time), no fixed sleep in a timed path, one tools/guarded.sh scope per metric

result.cold_or_warm: cold (fresh process per sample, boot classpath on page cache)
result.definition: process spawn -> Vm ready (boot classpath loaded), wall clock
result.note: wall is parent-measured spawn->first stdout line (includes exec, dynamic linking, rust init); in_process_ms excludes exec

result.cold_or_warm: first Vm in the process is cold; the reported in-process samples reuse the process-global boot cache (warm). See results/bench/MEMORY_PROFILE.md
result.note: stages mirror acos_runtime::boot::boot_app_process exactly (same public calls, same order); the probe fails loudly if the attach handshake is not recorded

result.cold_or_warm: cold per sample (fresh Vm + fresh boot)
result.definition: attachApplication received -> IApplicationThread.bindApplication delivered, and the main-looper phase that follows it
result.first_blocker: uncaught Ljava/util/MissingResourceException;: Could not find the bundle android/icu/impl/data/icudt72b/likelySubtags
result.note: the phase after bindApplication is expected to stop at the first unwired native (ICU regex / font config); the structured blocker is reported, never a stub

result.cold_or_warm: cold per sample (fresh process), settled 1000 ms
result.definition: settled memory of the runtime core with zero tasks
result.never: PSS and cgroup memory are never summed (BENCHMARKS.md §1)
result.type: RSS + PSS + anon+shmem (RssAnon+RssShmem) + private/shared, each labelled

booted.state: runtime core + booted framework app process (attach handshake done)

vm.state: runtime core only, zero tasks (Vm ready, framework not booted)

result.cold_or_warm: fresh process per N; sessions are in-process and sequential
result.definition: per-session incremental (loaded-bare)/N and marginal (total(high)-total(low))/(high-low) memory of the current boot path
result.limit: Runtime::with_host installs the process-global Binder transport, so N live runtimes are a memory experiment, not a working multi-session configuration

sharing.consequence: nothing is shareable between sessions today: private pages grow with N and shared pages are flat (see private_kib/rss_file_kib per N)
sharing.evidence: the boot classpath and app DEX are read with std::fs::read and parsed into the VM heap; no mmap is used, so their pages are private anonymous pages

result.type: anon+shmem (RssAnon+RssShmem) with PSS and private/shared reported separately

result.cold_or_warm: fresh process per N; sessions booted sequentially and all kept alive
result.definition: total + per-session incremental/marginal memory of N independent in-process sessions that share the immutable boot classpath (raw DEX, parsed DexFile, decoded method bodies) through process-global caches
result.limit: Runtime::with_host installs the process-global Binder transport, so N live runtimes are a memory experiment for trusted agent-owned workloads, not N isolated untrusted tenants. Processes remain the isolation unit; see results/bench/MEMORY_PROFILE.md

footprint.method: exact Vec/String capacities + DexFile slice lengths; lookup_maps/natives rows carry a one-byte-per-entry control estimate and are marked _approx

exact Vec/String capacities + DexFile slice lengths; lookup_maps/natives rows carry a one-byte-per-entry control estimate and are marked _approx

sharing.decoded_code: one MethodCode per (DexFile::id, code_off) per process (acos_vm::codecache)

footprint.method: exact Vec/String capacities + DexFile slice lengths; lookup_maps/natives rows carry a one-byte-per-entry control estimate and are marked _approx

sharing.not_shared: nothing mutable is shared: no handles, class ids, statics or heap slots cross a Vm
sharing.per_session: class table, statics, types, interner, guest heap, stacks (separate heaps)
sharing.raw_dex: one Arc<[u8]> + parsed DexFile per boot file per process (acos_dex::cache)

result.type: anon+shmem (RssAnon+RssShmem) with PSS and private/shared reported separately
result.unit: KiB (MiB convenience columns); structural footprint in bytes

result.cold_or_warm: warm (after boot + bind phase, main looper parked or run stopped)
result.definition: process CPU ticks consumed while the runtime is parked/blocked, over a wall window
result.note: a parked looper must burn zero ticks; a non-zero tick count is reported as-is
result.unit: ticks (CLK_TCK=100 assumed on x86_64) and % of one core

result.cold_or_warm: fresh Vm per sample; the first sample in the process parses the boot classpath, later samples reuse the process-global boot cache (warm). See results/bench/MEMORY_PROFILE.md
result.definition: interpreted DEX program wall time and interpreted instructions
result.note: ACOS-only: legacy ACVM published no interpreter micro benchmarks, so these rows have no legacy counterpart (host-JVM numbers live in results/vm, a different engine and fidelity)
